datasets.title: Satellite detected water extent in Bagmati, Gandaki, Lumbini and Madhesh Provinces, Nepal as of 01 & 06 October 2024
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: FL20240928NPL This map illustrates the floods using Sentinel-2 images acquired on 01 & 06 October 2024 at 10:42 local time (04:57 UTC). Within the analysed area of about 18,000 km², a total of about 300 km² of land appears to be affected by flood waters. Based on Worldpop spatial demographic data, about 115,000 people are exposed or living close to flooded areas. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/water-extent-in-bagmati-gandaki-lumbini-and-madhesh-provinces-nepal-as-of-01-06-october-20]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts processed Sentinel-2 satellite imagery acquired on 01 & 06 October 2024 to detect flood water extent through multi-temporal change detection analysis. The delineated inundation area (~300 km²) was spatially intersected with WorldPop gridded population data to estimate approximately 115,000 people exposed or living close to flooded areas across Bagmati, Gandaki, Lumbini and Madhesh Provinces.
